finding.share: This happens in {{n}} of {{total}} combinations of conditions.

unknown.how: See the details below, under “Technical details”.

slot-never-routed.title: The “{{signature}}” signature never appears in any submission, whatever the conditions
slot-never-routed.how: Add this signature to the document or to the signing order of a submission, or remove it from the version’s list of signatures.

route-step-without-person.title: “{{point}}” has a signing step that waits for a person who is missing: {{people}}
route-step-without-person.how: If the person is required, do not allow a project without them. If not, make the step depend on the person so it appears only when the person is there.

route-gap.title: “{{point}}” needs signatures, but sometimes there is nobody to sign
route-gap.how: Add the author’s signature or the signature of a person who is present in such projects, or do not allow a project without a supervisor.

visible-if-unknown-field.title: A form field is shown depending on a field that does not exist in the form
visible-if-unknown-field.how: Pick an existing field of the same form in the display condition, or remove the condition: otherwise the field never appears.

visible-if-value-not-in-options.title: A form field waits for an answer that cannot be chosen
visible-if-value-not-in-options.how: Take the value from the options of the field the display depends on, or remove the condition: otherwise the field never appears.

meta.title: A required project data field is hidden under all conditions
meta.how: It cannot be filled in. Allow showing it for suitable kinds of work or make it optional.

form.title: A required form or its fields are hidden under all conditions
form.how: They cannot be filled in. Allow showing them for suitable kinds of work or make them optional.

other.title: A required field is hidden under all conditions
other.how: It cannot be filled in. Allow showing it for suitable kinds of work or make it optional.

field-never-visible.title: A field is hidden under all conditions: the student will never see it
field-never-visible.how: Check for which kinds of work and answers the field is shown, or delete it.

langs.title: Document “{{document}}” is meant for languages the version does not have: {{langs}}
langs.how: Add these languages to the version together with the files, or remove them from the document.

plain.title: Document “{{document}}” is meant for a language the version does not have
plain.how: Add the language to the version together with the files, or remove it from the document.

skip-if-nda-without-nda.title: Document “{{document}}” in “{{point}}” is skipped under an NDA, but the version has no NDA
skip-if-nda-without-nda.how: Add an NDA to the version or remove the skip condition.

person.title: A signature condition names a person who is not among the roles
person.how: Pick a role from the list: supervisor, co-supervisor or academic supervisor.

slot.title: A condition refers to a signature that is not in the version’s list of signatures
slot.how: Add such a signature to the version or fix its name.

document.title: A condition refers to a document that is not in the version
document.how: Add the document to the version or fix its name.

when-never-held.title: The “{{signature}}” signature of document “{{document}}” in “{{point}}” never appears
when-never-held.how: Check which person the condition speaks about and whether such a person exists in projects. Or this document is never in the kit for this submission.

when-always-held.title: The condition of the “{{signature}}” signature of document “{{document}}” in “{{point}}” always holds
when-always-held.how: The condition is redundant: remove it if everyone needs the signature, or narrow it.

slot-when-overlap.title: The “{{signature}}” signature of document “{{document}}” in “{{point}}” has two conditions that can hold together
slot-when-overlap.how: Make the conditions mutually exclusive (for example, different supervisor roles) or keep one: otherwise the signature gets two signers.

document-never-active.title: Document “{{document}}” never gets into the kit, whatever the conditions
document-never-active.how: Check which kinds of work and staffings it is assigned to: they may not overlap. Or delete the document.

item-never-active.title: Document “{{document}}” is never submitted in “{{point}}”, although it can be in the kit
item-never-active.how: Check the kinds of work and the NDA skip of this item: together with the document’s conditions they leave no case.

all.title: “{{point}}” is empty under all conditions: nothing to submit
all.how: Check for which kinds of work the documents of this submission are assigned.

some.title: “{{point}}” is empty in {{n}} of {{total}} combinations of conditions: nothing to submit
some.how: This is fine if the submission is not needed for every kind of work. Otherwise check for which kinds of work its documents are assigned.

name.title: A name has no translation: {{langs}}
name.how: Add the translation or remove the language from the version.

hint.title: A hint has no translation: {{langs}}
hint.how: Add the translation or remove the language from the version.

manualsField.title: The manuals documents exist, but the project has no field to choose manuals
manualsField.how: Add a manuals choice field to the project data or remove these documents.

manualsOptions.title: The manuals options do not match the words Studio uses to include documents
manualsOptions.how: Name the options so that the name of the manual appears in them.

ndaDocument.title: The NDA document exists, but the project has no NDA switch
ndaDocument.how: Add an NDA switch to the project data or remove the document.

ndaField.title: The NDA switch exists, but there is no NDA document
ndaField.how: Add the NDA document or remove the switch.

dimension-no-effect.title: The condition “{{condition}}” changes nothing
dimension-no-effect.how: That is fine if the field is only printed in documents. Otherwise check the conditions that should take it into account.

jinja-fail-open.title: The template text of document “{{document}}” cannot be filled in with data
jinja-fail-open.how: Fix the expression in the template or guard the value against empty data. While the error stays, the raw template text ends up in the PDF.

jinja-unknown-meta-key.title: The template of document “{{document}}” reads a project field that does not exist
jinja-unknown-meta-key.how: Add the field to the project data or fix its name in the template: for now the value is always empty.

numbers.title: The template is too large for a full check: {{rows}} combinations of conditions, limit {{limit}}
numbers.how: Fix the values of some conditions in “What affects what”: the check will fit into the limit.

plain.title: The template is too large for a full check
plain.how: Fix the values of some conditions in “What affects what”: the check will fit into the limit.

docker.title: Docker is not running
docker.how: Start Docker Desktop, wait until it is up and build again.

image.title: The image for building PDFs is not installed
image.how: Open Studio settings, the builds section, install the image and build again.

environment.title: The computer that builds PDFs is not ready
environment.how: Restart Docker Desktop and build again. If that does not help, pass the technical details to the administrator.

nobuilder.title: There is nobody to build the PDF right now
nobuilder.how: Wait a minute and build again. If it keeps happening, tell the administrator: no build executor is available.

lost.title: The build was interrupted for technical reasons
lost.how: Build again. If that does not help, pass the technical details to the administrator.

memory.title: The build ran out of memory
memory.how: Make the pictures in the document smaller and build again.

space.title: The build ran out of disk space
space.how: Remove large files from the project and build again.

slow.title: The build took too long
slow.how: Build again. If it repeats, check the document for very large pictures or endless repeats.

quota.title: The maximum number of builds is running
quota.how: Wait for one of them to finish and build again.

text.title: The document did not build: there is an error in the text
text.how: Open the build log: the first line with “!” or with a line number shows the place. Fix the text and build again.

render.title: The template could not be filled in with data
render.how: Check the template texts for errors: the build may have failed or run too long.

nopdf.title: The build finished, but no PDF appeared
nopdf.how: Check that the document produces a PDF and that the start of the document is not commented out.

font.title: The computer that builds PDFs lacks a required font
font.how: Install the fonts (Times New Roman, Arial, Consolas) in Studio settings or replace the font in the document with a free one.

result.title: The build result could not be accepted
result.how: Build again. If it repeats, pass the technical details to the administrator.

network.title: No connection to the server
network.how: Check your network and build again.

unknown.title: The PDF did not build
unknown.how: Build again. If that does not help, pass the technical details to the administrator.

label.skipped: “{{point}}”: signature “{{signature}}” of document “{{document}}” is not needed, condition not met
label.mayAdd: “{{point}}”: signatures the author can switch on

reason.kind: not for this kind of work
